verdicts.reason: A has a clean left axis, a strong headline, readable text and chips in one row. Its flaws are a big dead gap between headline and subcopy, a CTA wedged beside the subcopy instead of below it, chips in reversed order, and tiny legal text. B has a cramped, ragged lower half: the CTA is centred while everything else is left-aligned, and the three chips are scattered at three different offsets and sizes with almost-touching edges. The legal text is off-axis and the headline overlaps the circle. B reads as jumbled and unintentional.
